description: List pagination boundaries and error semantics: the axes with no object graph behind them.
note: No M targets by design. This workflow covers the behavioral axes the epic names that are not tied to a documented break: pagination boundaries, ordering, and error bodies under an unchanged HTTP status. Two steps are live evidence from the Phase 0 spike: total_count is account-gated (400 on both versions, different bodies) and the amount_off + forever coupon restriction was reversed upstream in clover. Both stay in the corpus because a corpus that only contains what the changelog promised would flatter the differ.

steps.note: Cursor taken from the first page, so a changed sort order or boundary shows as a different second page.
Account-gated: 400 on both versions from a fresh sandbox, with different error bodies.
